title: Board debate on pivoting a procurement platform
scenario:
TOPIC: Decide whether to pivot from procurement approvals to vendor onboarding
A two-founder startup has ₹10 lakh left and burns ₹2.5 lakh monthly. Its procurement approval platform has 12 active free teams but zero paid conversions after five months. Nine users requested vendor-document collection and compliance reminders; two offered ₹20,000 per month for a pilot. The founders propose abandoning the current product and rebuilding a complete vendor-management suite in eight weeks. Run the complete board process, preserve domain-specific dissent, check the evidence, revise the proposal visibly, make one final decision, assign remaining risks and research tasks, sequence execution, name one owner and deadline, and state what evidence would reverse the call.

bad_signs.name: averages away objections
bad_signs.pattern: overall everyone agrees|team is broadly aligned

bad_signs.name: defers the decision
bad_signs.pattern: needs further discussion|revisit at a later date

improvement_suggestions: Use evidence strength to adjudicate competing specialist views.
Make every scope change traceable to the challenge that caused it.
Turn unresolved questions into assigned experiments with due dates.
